label: Atmosphere
help: Place the ground surface with this entity's Transform. Select a directional light as the Sun.

properties.label: Preset
properties.help: Spherical clear atmosphere with Earth-like molecules, aerosols and ozone.

properties.label: Sun
properties.help: Bind an existing directional light. An empty or missing reference uses the ordinary background.

properties.label: Solar angular radius
properties.help: Apparent angular radius of the Sun.

properties.label: Night sky
properties.help: Show stars beyond the atmosphere. A linked Earth celestial driver adds the Milky Way and visible planets for its date and observer location.

properties.label: Moon
properties.help: Bind a different directional light to the optional lunar disk. Its Transform or celestial driver sets the direction.
